name: Naive UI
summary: Open-source Vue 3 component library written in TypeScript with a customizable theme system, published by the tusen-ai GitHub organization (the LICENSE copyright holder is TuSimple).
notes: The docs site is a client-rendered SPA at naiveui.com. Deep links such as /en-US/os-theme/docs/introduction return HTTP 404 with the same app shell to non-JS clients, so the root URL (200) is recorded as both homepage and docs, and the repo README links only to www.naiveui.com. Ingestion should prefer the repo's docs sources over crawling the SPA. organization.websiteUrl is null (no verified TuSimple URL). npm latest 2.45.3 (2026-08-27).
